lines.1: After school, the day before the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.3: 「We already finished the drama-club meeting, right?」
lines.7: 「Just in case, can you give me your number as an emergency contact?」
lines.8: 「Coordination will be important tomorrow. Normally we probably wouldn't need it, but I want to be completely prepared.」
lines.11: 「Mm. Let me borrow it for a second.」
lines.12: Konoe entered the number into my phone.
lines.13: Her phone had a cute little strap on it.
lines.14: Surprisingly normal taste in that department.
lines.16: 「I'll give you a one-ring call from my phone now.」
lines.17: 「If anything urgent happens, call that number.」
lines.19: 「...Just so we're clear, don't call me for anything else.」
lines.20: 「Dooon't call me for anything else, okaaaay? (in a ridiculously high voice)」
lines.21: 「What was THAT!? That imitation really pisses me off!」
lines.22: 「I'm the one who's pissed! Everything you say is irritating!」
lines.23: 「I really don't like you after all...!」
lines.24: 「Hmph. The number calling you right now is mine.」
lines.26: 「Why did you answer!? What a waste!」
